toolkit.pageSubtitle: Practical checklists, device security configurations, and rapid call triage tools to safeguard your household and elderly family members.
toolkit.triageSubtitle: Select the specific situation you are currently experiencing to receive instant tactical guidance.
toolkit.triageSelectPrompt: What is the caller or sender claiming?
toolkit.pocketGuideDesc: Keep these verified national helplines and safety protocols accessible for all family members.

unknownSources.title: Disable Installation from Unknown Sources
unknownSources.desc: Prevents accidental downloads of malware APKs from WhatsApp, SMS, or deceptive browser redirects.
unknownSources.howTo: Open Settings > Security > Special App Access > Install Unknown Apps. Ensure all browsers and WhatsApp are set to 'Not Allowed'.

accessibility.title: Audit Sensitive Accessibility Permissions
accessibility.desc: Malicious apps abuse accessibility services to silently read screen content and two-factor bank OTPs.
accessibility.howTo: Open Settings > Accessibility > Downloaded Apps / Installed Services. Turn OFF any services that are not genuine accessibility tools.

safeword.title: Establish a Secret Family Safe-Word
safeword.desc: Defends against AI voice cloning and spoofed emergency distress calls claiming a family member is in police custody.
safeword.howTo: Choose a memorable word known only to immediate family. If anyone calls claiming an emergency, ask for the safe-word before transferring money.

upiLimit.title: Set a Conservative Daily UPI Limit
upiLimit.desc: Caps maximum exposure if a phone is lost, stolen, or compromised by an unauthorized collect request.
upiLimit.howTo: Open your bank's mobile application > UPI Settings > Transaction Limits. Set daily transaction limit to ₹5,000 - ₹10,000 for regular daily use.

secondaryAccount.title: Segregate Primary Savings & Daily UPI
secondaryAccount.desc: Keep life savings in a bank account without UPI activated. Maintain only minimal working funds in your UPI-linked daily account.
secondaryAccount.howTo: Link a secondary bank account (with ₹2,000 - ₹5,000 balance) to Google Pay/PhonePe/Paytm, protecting primary retirement savings from direct compromise.

simHygiene.title: Enable SIM Card PIN Protection
simHygiene.desc: Prevents fraudsters from swapping your physical SIM card into another phone to steal OTPs if your device is misplaced.
simHygiene.howTo: Open Settings > Security > SIM Card Lock > Enable Lock SIM Card. Set a custom 4-digit PIN (different from your birthday).

arrest.trigger: Caller claiming to be Police/CBI/Customs on video call demanding money for 'bail' or 'case clearance'
arrest.verdict: 100% Extortion Scam. Indian police, CBI, or judges NEVER conduct trials, issue arrest warrants, or accept bail funds via WhatsApp or Skype video calls.
arrest.action: Disconnect the call immediately. Do NOT transfer any money. Report the phone number to 1930 and Chakshu (sancharsaathi.gov.in).

screenshare.trigger: Caller asking you to download AnyDesk, RustDesk, or TeamViewer to 'fix a banking or SIM issue'
screenshare.verdict: Remote Screen Sharing Trap. Once installed, the scammer watches your screen in real time, recording bank passwords and intercepting SMS OTPs.
screenshare.action: Never install remote control applications upon a caller's request. If already downloaded, immediately disconnect Wi-Fi / Mobile Data and uninstall the app.

qrpin.trigger: Someone sent a QR code and told you to enter your UPI PIN to 'receive a prize, payment, or refund'
qrpin.verdict: Financial Theft Trap. A UPI PIN is NEVER required to receive money. Entering your PIN always deducts money from your bank account.
qrpin.action: Do not scan the QR code and never type your UPI PIN. Block the sender on your payment application.

apk.trigger: SMS claiming electricity or SIM will be disconnected tonight unless you call a number or install an APK file
apk.verdict: Banking Malware Vector. The APK will stealthily read incoming bank OTPs and forward them to offshore servers.
apk.action: Delete the message. Verify your electricity bill directly on your official discom portal or dial toll-free 1912.

toolkit.pocketCardSub: Keep near telephone or refrigerator for seniors and family members
toolkit.rule1Bold: Never enter a UPI PIN to receive money.
toolkit.rule1Text: PIN is strictly for debiting your account.
toolkit.rule2Bold: No police officer interrogates on WhatsApp video calls.
toolkit.rule4Bold: If money was debited, call 1930 immediately
